sources.finding: MRR@25 awards reciprocal first-correct rank and zero if absent. Retrieved via indexed official page; direct page text was unavailable.

Spectrum heterogeneity, preprocessing and chemical similarity leakage complicate generalization; scaffold/edit-distance splits challenge identity-only evaluation. This supports validation methodology, not a proven hidden gain for our pipeline.

Class shares and source/pretraining exposure change validation conclusions; seed sensitivity and same-structure exclusion matter. Reported hidden-class estimates are author hypotheses, not facts about our hidden test.
Author describes same-formula isomer errors, limited extra database recall and disagreement between validation panels; checked against our own used240 error audit.
Author reports optimistic exposed-panel validation reversing on a disjoint full-pipeline panel; candidate absence dominated their errors. Independent report, not our measurement.
Author reports improved fingerprint-channel retrieval failing to improve the full pipeline; changing ranker features and source rows did not automatically fix transfer. No weights/code adopted.
